<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_CreditScoring" targetNamespace="http://bank.example/bpmn/creditscoring">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ScoringDelay" name="Scoring delayed notice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ScoringResult" name="Scoring result"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_CreditScoring">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Bank" name="Banking System" processRef="Process_Banking"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Agency" name="Credit Scoring Agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Request" name="Scoring request" sourceRef="Task_SendRequest" targetRef="Participant_Agency" messageRef="Msg_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Delay" name="Delay notice" sourceRef="Participant_Agency" targetRef="Ev_Delay"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Result1" name="Immediate result" sourceRef="Participant_Agency" targetRef="Ev_Result1"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Result2" name="Level 2 result" sourceRef="Participant_Agency" targetRef="Ev_Result2"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Banking" name="Banking Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Banking">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SalesClerk" name="Sales Clerk (Frontend)">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_ScoringRequested</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ShowResult1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ShowResult2</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Result1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Result2</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_BankingSystem" name="Banking System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_ScoringOutcome</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Ev_Result1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Ev_Delay</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ShowDelay</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Ev_Result2</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ScoringRequested" name="Credit scoring requested by clerk">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequest" name="Send scoring request to agency">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gw_ScoringOutcome" name="Scoring outcome">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Ev_Result1" name="Immediate result received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Result1" messageRef="Msg_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Ev_Delay" name="Delay notice received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Delay" messageRef="Msg_ScoringDelay"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ShowResult1" name="Show result at frontend">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Result1" name="Result shown">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ShowDelay" name="Display message to check again later">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Ev_Result2" name="Level 2 result received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Result2" messageRef="Msg_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ShowResult2" name="Show result at frontend">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Result2" name="Result shown after delay">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_ScoringRequested" targetRef="Task_SendRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_SendRequest" targetRef="Gw_ScoringOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Gw_ScoringOutcome" targetRef="Ev_Result1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gw_ScoringOutcome" targetRef="Ev_Delay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Ev_Result1" targetRef="Task_ShowResult1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_ShowResult1" targetRef="End_Result1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Ev_Delay" targetRef="Task_ShowDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_ShowDelay" targetRef="Ev_Result2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Ev_Result2" targetRef="Task_ShowResult2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_ShowResult2" targetRef="End_Result2"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_CreditScoring" targetNamespace="http://bank.example/bpmn/creditscoring">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_CreditScoringRequest" name="Credit scoring request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ScoringResult" name="Scoring result"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ScoringDelay" name="Scoring delay notice"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_CreditScoring">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Clerk" name="Sales Clerk (Frontend)" processRef="Process_Clerk"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Banking" name="Banking System" processRef="Process_Banking"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Agency" name="Credit Scoring Agency" processRef="Process_Agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ClerkRequest" name="Credit scoring request" sourceRef="Task_RequestScoring" targetRef="Start_BankRequest" messageRef="Msg_CreditScoringRequest"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ImmediateResult" name="Immediate result" sourceRef="Task_SendImmediateResult" targetRef="Ev_ImmediateResult" messageRef="Msg_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_DelayNotice" name="Delay notice" sourceRef="Task_SendDelayNotice" targetRef="Ev_DelayNotice" messageRef="Msg_ScoringDelay"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Level2Result" name="Level 2 result" sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2Result" targetRef="Ev_Level2Result" messageRef="Msg_ScoringResult"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Clerk" name="Sales Clerk Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Clerk" name="Credit scoring needed">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RequestScoring" name="Request credit scoring via frontend">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Clerk" name="Scoring requested">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C2</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="Start_Clerk" targetRef="Task_RequestScoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Task_RequestScoring" targetRef="End_Clerk"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Banking" name="Banking Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_BankRequest" name="Credit scoring requested by clerk">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_BankStart" messageRef="Msg_CreditScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequestToAgency" name="Send scoring request to agency">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_B1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gw_AwaitAgencyReply" name="Agency reply">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_B2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Ev_ImmediateResult" name="Immediate result received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_B3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B5</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ImmediateResult" messageRef="Msg_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Ev_DelayNotice" name="Delay notice received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_B4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B6</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_DelayNotice" messageRef="Msg_ScoringDelay"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ShowDelayToClerk" name="Display message to clerk to check again later">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_B6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Ev_Level2Result" name="Level 2 result received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_B7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B8</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Level2Result" messageRef="Msg_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_ResultMerge" name="Result available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_B5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_B8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PresentResult" name="Present result to clerk at frontend">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_B9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ResultPresented" name="Result presented at frontend">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_B10</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B1" sourceRef="Start_BankRequest" targetRef="Task_SendRequestToAgency"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B2" sourceRef="Task_SendRequestToAgency" targetRef="Gw_AwaitAgencyReply"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B3" sourceRef="Gw_AwaitAgencyReply" targetRef="Ev_ImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B4" sourceRef="Gw_AwaitAgencyReply" targetRef="Ev_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B5" sourceRef="Ev_ImmediateResult" targetRef="Gw_ResultMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B6" sourceRef="Ev_DelayNotice" targetRef="Task_ShowDelayToClerk"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B7" sourceRef="Task_ShowDelayToClerk" targetRef="Ev_Level2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B8" sourceRef="Ev_Level2Result" targetRef="Gw_ResultMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B9" sourceRef="Gw_ResultMerge" targetRef="Task_PresentResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B10" sourceRef="Task_PresentResult" targetRef="End_ResultPresented"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Agency" name="Credit Scoring Agency Process" isExecutable="false">

      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_AgencyStart" messageRef="Msg_ScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level1Scoring" name="Perform level 1 scoring">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_ScoringDetermined" name="Scoring determined immediately?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendImmediateResult" name="Send immediate result to banking system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ImmediateResultSent" name="Immediate result sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A5</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDelayNotice" name="Send delay notice to banking system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level2Scoring" name="Perform level 2 scoring">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLevel2Result" name="Send scoring result to banking system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Level2ResultSent" name="Level 2 result sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A8</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A1" sourceRef="Start_AgencyRequest" targetRef="Task_Level1Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A2" sourceRef="Task_Level1Scoring" targetRef="Gw_ScoringDetermined"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A3" name="Immediate result" sourceRef="Gw_ScoringDetermined" targetRef="Task_SendImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A4" name="Scoring delayed" sourceRef="Gw_ScoringDetermined" targetRef="Task_SendDelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A5" sourceRef="Task_SendImmediateResult" targetRef="End_ImmediateResultSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A6" sourceRef="Task_SendDelayNotice" targetRef="Task_Level2Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A7" sourceRef="Task_Level2Scoring" targetRef="Task_SendLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A8" sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2Result" targetRef="End_Level2ResultSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_CreditScoring" targetNamespace="http://bank.example/bpmn/creditscoring">

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ScoringResult" name="Scoring result"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ScoringDelay" name="Scoring delay notice"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_CreditScoring">

    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Banking" name="Banking System" processRef="Process_Banking"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Agency" name="Credit Scoring Agency" processRef="Process_Agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ClerkRequest" name="Credit scoring request" sourceRef="Task_Clerk_Request" targetRef="Start_FE_Request" messageRef="Msg_CreditScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_FrontendToBank" name="Credit scoring request" sourceRef="Task_FE_Forward" targetRef="Start_BankRequest" messageRef="Msg_CreditScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_BankToAgency" name="Scoring request" sourceRef="Task_SendRequestToAgency" targetRef="Start_AgencyRequest" messageRef="Msg_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_AgencyImmediateResult" name="Immediate result" sourceRef="Task_SendImmediateResult" targetRef="Ev_ImmediateResult" messageRef="Msg_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_AgencyDelayNotice" name="Delay notice" sourceRef="Task_SendDelayNotice" targetRef="Ev_DelayNotice" messageRef="Msg_ScoringDelay"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_AgencyLevel2Result" name="Level 2 result" sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2Result" targetRef="Ev_Level2Result" messageRef="Msg_ScoringResult"/>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CL1</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CL2</bpmn:incoming>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Ev_FE_Immediate" name="Immediate result received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FE3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FE5</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FE4</bpmn:incoming>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FE8</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gw_AwaitAgencyReply" name="Agency reply">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BK2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BK3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BK4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Ev_ImmediateResult" name="Immediate result received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BK3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BK5</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ImmediateResult" messageRef="Msg_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Ev_DelayNotice" name="Delay notice received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BK4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BK6</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_DelayNotice" messageRef="Msg_ScoringDelay"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PresentImmediateResult" name="Present immediate result at frontend">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BK5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BK7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ShowDelayToClerk" name="Display check-again-later message at frontend">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BK6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BK8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Ev_Level2Result" name="Level 2 result received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BK8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BK9</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Level2Result" messageRef="Msg_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PresentLevel2Result" name="Present level 2 result at frontend">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BK9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BK10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_BankMerge" name="Result forwarded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BK7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BK10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BK11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Bank" name="Result presented at frontend">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BK11</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BK1" sourceRef="Start_BankRequest" targetRef="Task_SendRequestToAgency"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BK2" sourceRef="Task_SendRequestToAgency" targetRef="Gw_AwaitAgencyReply"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BK3" sourceRef="Gw_AwaitAgencyReply" targetRef="Ev_ImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BK4" sourceRef="Gw_AwaitAgencyReply" targetRef="Ev_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BK5" sourceRef="Ev_ImmediateResult" targetRef="Task_PresentImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BK6" sourceRef="Ev_DelayNotice" targetRef="Task_ShowDelayToClerk"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BK7" sourceRef="Task_PresentImmediateResult" targetRef="Gw_BankMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BK8" sourceRef="Task_ShowDelayToClerk" targetRef="Ev_Level2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BK9" sourceRef="Ev_Level2Result" targetRef="Task_PresentLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BK10" sourceRef="Task_PresentLevel2Result" targetRef="Gw_BankMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BK11" sourceRef="Gw_BankMerge" targetRef="End_Bank"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Agency" name="Credit Scoring Agency Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_AgencyRequest" name="Scoring request received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AG1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_AgencyStart" messageRef="Msg_ScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level1Scoring" name="Perform level 1 scoring">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AG1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AG2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_ScoringDetermined" name="Scoring determined immediately?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AG2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AG3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AG4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendImmediateResult" name="Send immediate result to banking system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AG3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AG5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ImmediateResultSent" name="Immediate result sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AG5</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDelayNotice" name="Send delay notice to banking system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AG4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AG6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level2Scoring" name="Perform level 2 scoring">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AG6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AG7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLevel2Result" name="Send scoring result to banking system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AG7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AG8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Level2ResultSent" name="Level 2 result sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AG8</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AG1" sourceRef="Start_AgencyRequest" targetRef="Task_Level1Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AG2" sourceRef="Task_Level1Scoring" targetRef="Gw_ScoringDetermined"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AG3" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gw_ScoringDetermined" targetRef="Task_SendImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AG4" name="No" sourceRef="Gw_ScoringDetermined" targetRef="Task_SendDelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AG5" sourceRef="Task_SendImmediateResult" targetRef="End_ImmediateResultSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AG6" sourceRef="Task_SendDelayNotice" targetRef="Task_Level2Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AG7" sourceRef="Task_Level2Scoring" targetRef="Task_SendLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AG8" sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2Result" targetRef="End_Level2ResultSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_CreditScoring" targetNamespace="http://bank.example/bpmn/creditscoring">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ClerkRequest" name="Credit scoring request from clerk"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_CreditScoringRequest" name="Credit scoring request to banking system"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request to agency"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Level1Outcome" name="Level 1 outcome or delay notice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Level2Result" name="Level 2 scoring result"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_FrontendUpdate" name="Result or delay notice for frontend"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_CreditScoring">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Clerk" name="Sales Clerk" processRef="Process_Clerk"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Frontend" name="Frontend Application" processRef="Process_Frontend"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Banking" name="Banking System" processRef="Process_Banking"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Agency" name="Credit Scoring Agency" processRef="Process_Agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ClerkRequest" name="Credit scoring request" sourceRef="Task_RequestScoring" targetRef="Start_AppRequest" messageRef="Msg_ClerkRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_FrontendToBanking" name="Credit scoring request" sourceRef="Task_SendRequestToBanking" targetRef="Start_BankRequest" messageRef="Msg_CreditScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_BankingToAgency" name="Scoring request" sourceRef="Task_SendRequestToAgency" targetRef="Start_AgencyRequest" messageRef="Msg_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_AgencyLevel1Outcome" name="Level 1 outcome or delay notice" sourceRef="SendTask_SendLevel1Outcome" targetRef="Ev_Level1Outcome" messageRef="Msg_Level1Outcome"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_BankingDelayToFrontend" name="Delay notice" sourceRef="Task_SendDelayToFrontend" targetRef="Ev_UpdateReceived" messageRef="Msg_FrontendUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_AgencyLevel2Result" name="Level 2 result" sourceRef="SendTask_SendLevel2Result" targetRef="Ev_Level2Result" messageRef="Msg_Level2Result"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_BankingResultToFrontend" name="Scoring result" sourceRef="Task_PresentResult" targetRef="Ev_UpdateReceived" messageRef="Msg_FrontendUpdate"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Clerk" name="Sales Clerk Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Clerk" name="Credit scoring needed for customer">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RequestScoring" name="Request credit scoring in frontend">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ClerkRequested" name="Scoring requested">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C2</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="Start_Clerk" targetRef="Task_RequestScoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Task_RequestScoring" targetRef="End_ClerkRequested"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Frontend" name="Frontend Application Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_AppRequest" name="Credit scoring requested by clerk">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_AppStart" messageRef="Msg_ClerkRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequestToBanking" name="Send credit scoring request to banking system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Ev_UpdateReceived" name="Result or delay notice received from banking system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_AppUpdate" messageRef="Msg_FrontendUpdate"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_UpdateForm" name="Result or delay notice?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F4</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ShowResult" name="Show result to clerk">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ShowDelayMessage" name="Show delay message to clerk: check again later">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_F6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ResultShown" name="Result shown at frontend">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_F7</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F1" sourceRef="Start_AppRequest" targetRef="Task_SendRequestToBanking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F2" sourceRef="Task_SendRequestToBanking" targetRef="Ev_UpdateReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F3" sourceRef="Ev_UpdateReceived" targetRef="Gw_UpdateForm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F4" name="Result" sourceRef="Gw_UpdateForm" targetRef="Task_ShowResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F5" name="Delay notice" sourceRef="Gw_UpdateForm" targetRef="Task_ShowDelayMessage"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F6" sourceRef="Task_ShowDelayMessage" targetRef="Ev_UpdateReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F7" sourceRef="Task_ShowResult" targetRef="End_ResultShown"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Banking" name="Banking Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_BankRequest" name="Credit scoring requested by frontend">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_BankStart" messageRef="Msg_CreditScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequestToAgency" name="Send scoring request to agency">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_B1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Ev_Level1Outcome" name="Level 1 outcome or delay notice received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_B2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Level1Outcome" messageRef="Msg_Level1Outcome"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_Level1Form" name="Result determined immediately?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_B3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B4</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDelayToFrontend" name="Display delay message to clerk at frontend">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_B5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Ev_Level2Result" name="Level 2 result received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_B6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B7</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Level2Result" messageRef="Msg_Level2Result"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_BankResultMerge" name="Result available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_B4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_B7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PresentResult" name="Present result to clerk at frontend">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_B8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_B9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ResultPresented" name="Result presented at frontend">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_B9</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B1" sourceRef="Start_BankRequest" targetRef="Task_SendRequestToAgency"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B2" sourceRef="Task_SendRequestToAgency" targetRef="Ev_Level1Outcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B3" sourceRef="Ev_Level1Outcome" targetRef="Gw_Level1Form"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B4" name="Result" sourceRef="Gw_Level1Form" targetRef="Gw_BankResultMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B5" name="Delay notice" sourceRef="Gw_Level1Form" targetRef="Task_SendDelayToFrontend"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B6" sourceRef="Task_SendDelayToFrontend" targetRef="Ev_Level2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B7" sourceRef="Ev_Level2Result" targetRef="Gw_BankResultMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B8" sourceRef="Gw_BankResultMerge" targetRef="Task_PresentResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_B9" sourceRef="Task_PresentResult" targetRef="End_ResultPresented"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Agency" name="Credit Scoring Agency Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_AgencyRequest" name="Scoring request received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_AgencyStart" messageRef="Msg_ScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level1Scoring" name="Perform level 1 scoring">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendLevel1Outcome" name="Send level 1 outcome or delay notice to banking system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_Level1Complete" name="Level 1 result determined?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A4</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level2Scoring" name="Perform level 2 scoring">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendLevel2Result" name="Send level 2 scoring result to banking system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_AgencyMerge" name="Scoring completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_A8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_AgencyDone" name="Scoring request completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_A8</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A1" sourceRef="Start_AgencyRequest" targetRef="Task_Level1Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A2" sourceRef="Task_Level1Scoring" targetRef="SendTask_SendLevel1Outcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A3" sourceRef="SendTask_SendLevel1Outcome" targetRef="Gw_Level1Complete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A4" name="Result determined" sourceRef="Gw_Level1Complete" targetRef="Gw_AgencyMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A5" name="Delayed" sourceRef="Gw_Level1Complete" targetRef="Task_Level2Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A6" sourceRef="Task_Level2Scoring" targetRef="SendTask_SendLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A7" sourceRef="SendTask_SendLevel2Result" targetRef="Gw_AgencyMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A8" sourceRef="Gw_AgencyMerge" targetRef="End_AgencyDone"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
